attested.notes: Director-liability rebuild. Opens on the reader's real question (does it follow me home) and answers in the second paragraph. Practitioner we is earned throughout: weekend assuming the worst, dig out the actual documents, former-registered-office search that turns up the unknown judgment, supplier squeeze as the real emergency. Warmth at the top and again at the decision point. Asymmetrical lines: 'It is not the judgment that engages the test. It is the failed attempt to enforce it' and 'reached by carrying on, not by getting the judgment'. Four legal overstatements corrected (CPR 13.2 vs 13.3, CCJ not proof of insolvency, s.239 desire test not the look-back window, N245 limited to the warrant and payment terms). Enforcement presented as creditor options, not a fixed sequence. No invented casework.
